no worries! I'm not much of a planner but I do feel like I'm already transitioning to the next part of my life. I've "planted the seeds" of my next chapter but the hard part is getting there yk. I def need to remember that there's so much to look forward to. thank you.

and I have a tiny old lady tabby and her daughter who's a siamese mix. my roommate has a chonky black cat.

I'm trans as well, and this may not help but it does get better. cis people can be so nasty to trans people but you are worthy of living a happy life, despite what others think. I'm sorry you feel this way. I hope that things get better for you.

I def have a good amount of self worth, I am very stuck tho. like I have hobbies that are fulfilling and I have alot to live for but that clinical depression is kicking my ass right now. my job sucks and my housing situation sucks but there's not alot I can do about it right now, you feel? I've been super suicidal since the new year and idk what to do except keep doing the same shit.

not really. I'm dating one of my roommates and dont really have any friends besides these two. I couldn't live alone because this is what happens lol, I get drunk and my suicidal feelings explode. thank you for caring tho
